enable_config.description: Enable reading configuration files (.clangd in project, clangd/config.yaml in user config dir).

compile_commands_dir.description: Path to a directory containing compile_commands.json. clangd falls back to searching parent directories if invalid or empty.

query_driver.description: List of glob patterns for compiler drivers that clangd may safely execute to extract system includes (e.g. /usr/bin/clang-*, /usr/bin/g++-*).

background_index.description: Enable background indexing and persist it to disk.

background_index_persist.description: Storage mode for background index. One of: CacheDirectory, Memory, MemoryMapped.

background_index_priority.description: Thread priority for background indexing. One of: background, low, normal.

all_scopes_completion.description: Include index symbols from all scopes (not only visible scopes) in completion suggestions.

completion_style.description: Granularity of completion suggestions. One of: detailed, bundled.

function_arg_placeholders.description: Include placeholders for function arguments in completions.

header_insertion.description: Control automatic #include insertion on completion. One of: iwyu, never.

header_insertion_decorators.description: Prepend a circular dot/space to completion labels depending on whether an include will be added.

import_insertions.description: Insert #import directives for Objective-C when header insertion is enabled.

limit_references.description: Maximum number of references returned (0 = unlimited).

limit_results.description: Maximum number of results returned (e.g., symbols, completions) (0 = unlimited).

rename_file_limit.description: Maximum number of files affected by a rename operation (0 = unlimited).

path_mappings.description: List of 'client_path=server_path' pairs to translate paths between client (editor) and server filesystems.

remote_index_address.description: Address (host:port) of a remote index server.

log.description: Log verbosity. One of: error, info, verbose.

offset_encoding.description: Force offset encoding used for character positions. One of: utf-8, utf-16, utf-32. Empty means negotiate via client capabilities.

j.description: Number of async workers (matches the -j CLI flag).

malloc_trim.description: Call malloc_trim(3) periodically to release unused memory.

pch_storage.description: Where to store precompiled headers. One of: disk, memory.

experimental_modules_support.description: Enable experimental support for C++20 standard modules.

fallback_style.description: Default clang-format style when no .clang-format file is found.

project_root.description: Path to the project root. Requires remote_index_address to be set.
